data.name: Messenger Flow
data.subtitle: Facebook Messenger tweak by dvntms (unofficial build)
data.localizedDescription: Messenger Flow is a tweaked Facebook Messenger build by dvntms, distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Messenger base version. The Flow tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.

compatibility.notes: UNOFFICIAL BUILD. Flow has no public repository or developer feed - the IPA Vault source is the only distribution channel, so no developer-published download link exists to verify. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Uses its own bundle identifier, so it installs alongside the stock App Store Messenger.
